    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Integrated Device Technology, Inc. realized record after merger with Renesas Electronics, ~3-5-year horizon (~2022-2024)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because the entity was acquired and deregistered,
> and its Japanese parent is not an SEC registrant, there is no post-closing public
> 10-K/20-F for the acquired business; the traceable realized record is limited to the
> deregistration filings and a search for any separate parent disclosure. This
> sub-dossier contains no information about how the transaction was structured at
> closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)

- On March 29, 2019, the same day the merger closed, IDT requested that Nasdaq suspend
  trading in its common stock, and The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC filed a Form 25-NSE
  removing IDT's common stock from listing and registration.
  [SRC: SEC accession 0001354457-19-000166, Form 25-NSE]
- On April 8, 2019, IDT filed a Form 15-12G certifying termination of registration of
  its common stock under Section 12(g) of the Exchange Act and/or suspension of its
  duty to file reports under Sections 13(a)/15(d); the filing recorded approximately 1
  holder of record as of the certification date and was signed by Sailesh Chittipeddi as
  President and CEO. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-19-100681, Form 15-12G]
- A review of IDT's EDGAR filing history (CIK 0000703361) finds no Form 10-K, Form 10-Q,
  or Form 20-F filed after the April 2019 deregistration; no periodic report covering
  any fiscal year within the ~2022-2024 outcome window was located.
  [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0000703361&type=10-K]
- Renesas Electronics Corporation is a Japanese corporation listed on the Tokyo Stock
  Exchange; a search of the SEC EDGAR company database for "Renesas" returns no
  registrant, indicating Renesas does not itself file periodic reports with the SEC and
  has no U.S. filing in which it could separately disclose the acquired IDT business's
  post-close trajectory. [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&company=renesas&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40]

## Items sought but not found

- General reputable-press reporting describes workforce reductions at Renesas
  Electronics, including a reported reduction of approximately 68 positions in the South
  Bay area (Renesas Electronics America is headquartered at IDT's former San Jose
  address) with an effective date reported as January 21, 2025 — after the ~2022-2024
  outcome window — and a separate global reduction of approximately 950 positions
  (4.5% of Renesas's global workforce) announced January 27, 2025, also outside the
  window; neither source ties the reduction specifically to the legacy IDT product
  lines or attributes a scalar to the acquired business as such, so these are not cited
  here as an in-window outcome fact. [UNVERIFIED]
- No primary filing or reputable press source was located reporting a divestiture,
  impairment, write-down, or comparable outcome scalar specifically attributed to the
  legacy IDT business within the ~2022-2024 window. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)

- Because IDT was acquired for cash and deregistered its securities within weeks of
  closing (Form 25-NSE and Form 15-12G, both in 2019), there is no public audited
  outcome record (10-K/20-F) for the acquired business in the ~2022-2024 window.
  [SRC: SEC accession 0001354457-19-000166, Form 25-NSE][SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-19-100681, Form 15-12G]
- The acquirer, Renesas Electronics Corporation, is a foreign private company reporting
  under Japanese law with no SEC registration found, and no source was located in which
  Renesas separately discloses the legacy IDT business's financial or operating
  trajectory. [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&company=renesas&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40]
- Per the no-record convention, this case is coded **uncertain** on the outcome for the
  acquired business: the absence of any public periodic-reporting record — from either
  the deregistered target or its non-SEC-registered foreign parent — precludes a sourced
  determination of the realized 3-5-year trajectory of the acquired business.

[SLICE END]
